## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a petite woman with thick, beautifully wavy snow-white hair that she wears carefully styled in becoming puffs and coils. Beneath her hair is an almost girlish, pink-cheeked face featuring dimples, sweet lips, and big, soft, wistful wood-brown eyes with little golden glints in them. Over time, her appearance remains unchanged other than growing even sweeter and prettier.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P12](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0012), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## History

Named Lavendar by her father for his love of the scent, Miss Lavendar Lewis lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young maid, Charlotta the Fourth, after a quarrel twenty-five years prior severed her engagement to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). After [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally discovered her home, Miss Lavendar befriended them and revealed the story of her past romance. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) subsequently introduced Stephen's son, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss Lavendar, and the two formed a warm, affectionate connection. Following a period of listlessness, Miss Lavendar was reunited with Stephen after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) served as a matchmaker, leading to their garden wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and departure from [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station. During later visits from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Lavendar hosted her at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and gently warned [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) were meant for each other.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +300 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 2**

- named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent of it  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake? Diana Barry? And Anne Shirley? May I pretend that I’ve known you for a hundred years and call you Anne and Diana right away?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

Lavendar Lewis and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) met when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), instantly recognizing each other as kindred spirits. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently visits Lavendar to keep her company, comfort her, and help around the lodge, even acting as the matchmaker who helped reunite Lavendar with her lost love. Their deep, warm friendship persists over the years, with Lavendar offering heartfelt romantic advice as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grows up.

- Friend of — close kindred-spirit friends  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), +2 more</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth is Lavendar Lewis's dedicated young house servant who helps manage [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) deeply cares for Lavendar's well-being, noticing when her mistress becomes listless or quiet and working alongside guests to prepare the home for special occasions. In turn, Lavendar employs and directs [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), maintaining a fond and cooperative dynamic in the household.

- Commands — employer who directs her house servant  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +3 more</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) first met Lavendar Lewis alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after wandering down an enchanted wood lane to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes a frequent, welcome guest who participates in tea parties and assists with the preparations for Lavendar's garden wedding. Their relationship is one of pleasant, fond hospitality, with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continuing to visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) during holiday breaks.

- Friend of — frequent guests who bring wholesome joy to her home  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Lavendar Lewis was previously engaged to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) before a long separation tore them apart. Through the assistance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), the two reunite years later, reigniting their romantic affection. They ultimately marry in a garden ceremony surrounded by friends.

- Romantically involved with — former lovers/reuniting suitors  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- Spouse of — to be married  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), +1 more</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is the young son of Lavendar's reunited love, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and quickly becomes a cherished companion to her. The two share an imaginative and poetic nature, bonding over shared conversations about imaginary dream-boys and playful stories. Lavendar offers him a warm, motherly affection as he navigates the process of growing up.

- Friend of — visiting young friend who shares her imagination  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Lavendar Lewis were originally engaged twenty-five years prior, but a long separation left Lavendar living alone at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). After [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a message from Stephen asking to see her, the two reunite in her garden and resolve their past. They soon marry in a garden wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together.

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- Spouse of — husband  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>
